verdict.rationale: Vendor marketing says ZCode uses multi-agent collaboration to complete complex goals (zcode-docs-1). Its 'Goal' feature does continuous planning, execution and verification for multi-step work (zcode-docs-2), and tasks can be triggered remotely via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram (zcode-docs-3). This suggests some long-running, multi-agent autonomy, but nothing shows launching parallel fleets of independent agents on separate tasks. missing for 10: explicit parallel multi-agent/fleet launching, evidence of agents running unattended for hours or days, per-agent isolation and task management, first-party technical docs beyond marketing claims, independent hands-on corroboration.
